From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Mike Larson <mike@orionfin.com>, Anya Patel <anya.patel@orionfin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MPA security gate: SIG/DPA/SOC 2 questions + retention timeline

Hi Mike / Anya —

Great to be moving this forward. Attached is a short MPA draft for Orion Financial (mpa_map_draft_v1.pdf) that focuses the security/compliance gates we usually run during evaluation. To keep the mutual action plan tight and executable, can you confirm the priority items below and whether your legal/security teams have any mandatory blockers?

High-level asks from your side we need to land in the MPA:
- Completed SIG/CAIQ (spreadsheet style) or confirmation which sections you want to skip
- SOC 2 evidence window (sample artifacts + timeline for attestation checkpoints)
- DPA redline + countersign timing; any non-negotiable clauses (e.g., data escrow, keystore language)
- Data retention window and residency requirements (EU residency / backup retention / archival timelines)

Proposed lightweight timeline (aligns with your Q1 pilot start):
- Dec 8: SIG/CAIQ intake (you return matrix)
- Dec 15: SOC 2 evidence stub (we provide sample artifacts / you confirm sufficiency)
- Dec 18: DPA comments exchanged
- Dec 22: Final sign (if SLA/DPA settled)
- Jan 3: POC onboarding (post-sign)

A couple of clarifications from our side that will help accelerate review: we typically provide SOC 2 artifact snapshots (config exports, access lists, incident runbooks) rather than full reports during evaluation; we have a standard DPA with EU residency options (we can vary residency by region for prod but evaluation data typically lives in our hosted region unless you request otherwise). Our default operational retention for non-prod logs is 1 year, backups 90 days, but we can discuss extended retention or escrow for regulated customers.

If convenient, can we do a 20‑minute triage call early next week to lock timeline? I’ve cc’d Marcus (security ops) and Kimberly (legal) to pick up any redlines quickly.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0192
Redwood Inference

From: Mike Larson <mike@orionfin.com>

Subject: Re: MPA security gate: SIG/DPA/SOC 2 questions + retention timeline

Rafael —

Thanks for the clear plan and draft. A few quick notes from OrionFin Legal & Security after a quick internal review (see attached matrix & DPA comments): orion_sig_matrix.xlsx, orion_dpa_comments.pdf.

Major asks / clarifications on our side:
- Retention: for production we need 7 years for transaction logs per our compliance team; for evaluation we can accept a shorter window but we need a documented retention policy and the ability to export historical logs before tear-down. Is there an automated export you can provide?
- EU residency: our pilot will include EU users. We need confirmation that PII from EU residents can be pinned to eu-west-1 or similar region for the POC stage.
- DPA: our legal redlines are conservative around subprocessors and access; we can share one round of redlines and expect a counter.
- SIG: we can complete the SIG, but there are a few custom questions about key management (HSM/KMS) and incident response that we'd like Redwood to answer inline.

We can do a call tomorrow (Tues) at 11:00 EST to go through the matrix — Anya will host. If Redwood can confirm export tooling for logs + residency option beforehand, that will speed legal signoff.

Best,
Mike Larson
Head of Compliance Operations | Orion Financial
mike@orionfin.com

Attachments: orion_sig_matrix.xlsx, orion_dpa_comments.pdf

1) Retention: can we commit to an evaluation-export workflow + state our default eval retention (we currently do 1 year logs, backups 90d). Is there a process to provide a one-time export of historical logs prior to tear-down?
2) Residency: for POC we can provision eu-west region for the pilot tenant? Is there any billing/ops lead time that would blow the Dec/Jan runway?
3) DPA: any clauses we cannot accept (subprocessor transparency / audit rights / escrow)? Kimberly — if you can take a pass on orion_dpa_comments.pdf and flag top 3 negotiables, I’ll loop legal on the call.

Mike / Anya — appreciate the call earlier. Quick summary of agreed MAP gates and owners so we have a single source of truth for close timing (DF-4821). Please treat this as the MAP section to include in the shared MPA doc.

Agreed security/compliance gates (evaluation phase):
1) SIG/CAIQ intake — Owner: OrionFin security; Due: 2027-12-08 (you to return completed matrix)
   - Redwood will provide inline answers for HSM/KMS, incident response runbook excerpts, and access-control diagrams.
2) SOC 2 evidence stub — Owner: Redwood security (Marcus) ; Due: 2027-12-15
   - Artifact types: mapping of controls, sample config exports, recent change logs. This is for evaluation only and not the full attestation.
3) DPA redline exchange — Owner: OrionFin legal (Anya) / Redwood legal (Kimberly) ; Exchange due: 2027-12-18
   - One round of redlines expected; Kimberley will propose approved counter language for subprocessors and audit window.
4) Retention & export confirmation — Owner: Redwood Ops (Marcus) ; Due: 2027-12-18
   - For evaluation: Redwood confirms automated export of evaluation logs prior to environment teardown. For production: retention policy options documented (1y default logs / 90d backups; Redwood ops to provide extended-retention proposal for 7y requirement).
5) Final sign / go-ahead for POC — Target close: 2027-12-22

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marcus to upload redwood_security_responses_v3.xlsx with inline SIG answers and evidence index by EOD 12/15.
- Kimberly to review orion_dpa_comments.pdf and return top-line counter language by 12/16.
- Rafael to circulate final MPA with these gates and host a 30min handoff call week of Dec 20 if needed.

If anything here needs to shift, call it out in reply and we’ll adjust. Calendar link for signoff call: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=orion-security-checkin

Thanks all — looking forward to getting the POC kicked off.

Regards,
